_about: Tests that fail today because of a known defect. Listed + failed with exactly its "expect" failures = reported as known-failing. Listed + failed for any other reason = the runner FAILS ("expect" lists one entry per failed assertion: the failed-assertion messages, as prefixes matched on a word boundary, each at least 3 words and 15 characters and not a generic throw/precondition/control/harness line; every failure line must match one, and every one must match a failure line). Listed + passed = the runner FAILS until the entry is removed (the fix must remove its own marker). Unlisted + failed = the runner FAILS. Keys are <page>#<test id>; defects are described in KNOWN-ISSUES.md.
